title: Treaty of Utrecht (1474)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Utrecht (1474)", at revision 1362593280, opens: "The Treaty of Utrecht was signed in 1474 after the Anglo-Hanseatic War between England and the Hanseatic League." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q559400, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty following the Anglo-Hanseatic war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
